name: Web MRI Volume Renderer
definition: A client-server architecture for interactive 3D volume rendering of dense MRI volumes (up to 512³) in a web browser. The client handles rendering and UI, while the server serves HDF5 volumes from disk.
summary: Web MRI Volume Renderer is a GPU-accelerated, WebAssembly-based client-server system that enables interactive 3D visualization of dense MRI volumes directly in a web browser.
